62K likes, 192 comments - nagmamirajkar on September 29, 2026: "Still thinking about what an incredible experience this was! 🥹

Being in Nagoya for the Asian Games and getting to witness the opening ceremony in person was honestly so special. From the spectacular performances and the energy in the stadium to seeing athletes from all across Asia come together, there was so much happening and I enjoyed every bit of it.

I had the BEST time, met some amazing people and got to experience so many moments that I’ll remember for a long, long time. Feeling super grateful that I got to be a part of something this special. ❤️

Nagoya, you were an experience! 🇯🇵
